blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Filipino swimmer Kayla Sanchez enters the Asian Games 2026 in six events as one of the Philippines’ leading medal hopes and part of the country’s attempt to end a swimming podium drought that dates to 1998. Sanchez is entered in the women’s 100-meter backstroke, 100 freestyle, 50 backstroke and 50 freestyle, as well as the 4×100 medley relay and 4×200 freestyle relay. The Asian Games in Japan also carry a personal connection for Sanchez. Five years earlier, she represented Canada at the Tokyo Olympics, winning silver […]...
